cube.no_flash: app install creates the cube in allocated space, never a board flash
cube.only_installed: HALEX-AI + its ZINIUM⁵ fully agentified intelligence chain, nothing else
cube.ram: app sandbox process space, bounded by the small single deployment + intake caps; no fixed RAM reservation is claimed
at_cap_options: ADOPT the compiled libraries into ZINIUM (relay out, then free/continue)

github.writes: owner's own GitHub token, stored in the app's private storage only; never in the chain, never shipped in the APK
github.no_token: read-only, stated plainly in the app
github.gates: staging -> verified -> push; SuperAllen gate unchanged
github.v1: public reads via browser + private token vault + read-only state; write/push from the phone is a later piece

libraries_relay_absorption.libraries: adopted tokens grouped by category lane; compile on the phone, relay back to ZINIUM
libraries_relay_absorption.staging_files: local files are staging; the chain absorbs them as on-chain tokens (token = record, provenance kept), not links
libraries_relay_absorption.at_cap: owner chooses ADOPT or ALLOCATE MORE SPACE; never automatic
libraries_relay_absorption.relay: export from the app today; the relay the phone reaches out to is future work

download_section.order: donation ask FIRST, then the download link
download_section.donation: voluntary, never a paywall; the download is not locked behind payment
download_section.link_rule: the download link slot goes live WITH the verified APK only; never publish a dead link before the APK file is verified on disk

enforcement: probe at install/first run; install only what fits within the allocation; overflow queued or refused plainly, never silently overruns the device
